brandbook.positioning: Herramienta ficticia de ejemplo de Esteban para recordar próximas lecturas y registrar cuáles se han leído, sin complejidad de catálogo y con datos guardados únicamente en el navegador.
brandbook.voice: Español breve, cercano y práctico. Acciones explícitas y mensajes honestos sobre almacenamiento local. Firma «Un ejemplo de Esteban». Sin lenguaje comercial, métricas ni promesas de sincronización.
brandbook.motif: Una línea vertical en el margen izquierdo del registro conecta los marcapáginas de cada libro. El contorno mantiene la identidad de la fila y su relleno distingue el estado, siempre acompañado por «Por leer» o «Leído».

pages.title: Brand guidelines
pages.summary: Herramienta ficticia de ejemplo de Esteban para recordar próximas lecturas y registrar cuáles se han leído, sin complejidad de catálogo y con datos guardados únicamente en el navegador.

examples.title: Cover composition
examples.text: Use a left-aligned title block. Keep the lilac support surface behind the violet bookmark so its complete silhouette remains visible.

pages.title: The Brand
pages.summary: Introduce the identity with one compact statement on violet. The bookmark and bibliographic rhythm should suggest a useful reading record, not a bookstore.

examples.title: A reading record
examples.text: Lista de lectura helps distinguish what is still to read from what has been read.

examples.title: Section composition
examples.text: Use white text on #6840AD and one supported bookmark. Avoid book covers, product imagery and catalog-style grids.

pages.title: Welcome
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.title: Identity scope
examples.text: Preserve the supplied name, Spanish signature, palette and Source Sans 3. The geometrical bookmark is an original proposal for this project.

examples.title: Product boundary
examples.text: Design one Spanish screen for adding books, changing reading status and filtering. Describe browser-only storage without implying accounts or synchronization.

pages.title: Index
pages.summary: Organize the guide into five sections. Use aligned page numbers and plum text rather than decorative chapter cards.

examples.title: Identity and logo
examples.text: 02–08 Brand definition and voice · 09–15 Logo system

examples.title: Visual language
examples.text: 16–22 Typography and layout · 23–29 Color, graphics and image direction

examples.title: Applications
examples.text: 30–49 Digital and physical design studies, assistance and colophon

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Make the continuous bibliographic record the organizing idea. Each full title, author, state and action belongs to one row rather than separate cards or columns.

examples.title: Record specimen
examples.text: Don Quijote de la Mancha · Miguel de Cervantes · Por leer · Marcar como leído

examples.title: Keep the record intact
examples.text: Use a white list with a connecting left rule. Do not split Por leer and Leídos into separate board columns.

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Treat these as project aims, not corporate declarations: make the next reading easy to remember and the current state easy to recognize.

examples.title: Purpose copy
examples.text: Guarda tu próxima lectura.

examples.title: Expression rule
examples.text: Lead with the record and its actions. Do not add aspirational claims about reading more, personal growth or a future service.

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Express the proposed design principles through visible choices: clarity in labels, continuity in rows and honesty in storage messages.

examples.title: Clarity and continuity
examples.text: Write Marcar como leído beside its book. Keep the same row when the state changes instead of presenting a separate receipt screen.

examples.title: Honesty
examples.text: Use Libro guardado en este navegador only after persistence is confirmed. Never replace it with Guardado para siempre.

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write short, practical Spanish. Name the action and its result; avoid commercial language, exaggerated celebration and vague recovery messages.

examples.title: Direct actions
examples.text: Guardar libro · Marcar como leído · Volver a por leer

examples.title: Useful recovery
examples.text: No se pudo confirmar el guardado. Tus campos se conservan. Reintentar.

examples.title: Exact signature
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Open the logo section on lilac. Show the bookmark and typeset name as two distinct elements, never as lettering embedded in the SVG.

examples.title: Identity lockup
examples.text: Lista de lectura

examples.title: Section treatment
examples.text: Place the violet bookmark to the left of plum type. Keep this page quiet enough to reveal the triangular notch.

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The logo combines a vertical bookmark with the exact name in Source Sans 3 Bold. Its square lilac support provides a consistent background across applications.

examples.title: Canonical geometry
examples.text: The 160 × 160 symbol contains a bookmark from x48 to x112 and y20 to y140, with its inward notch meeting at x80, y116.

examples.title: Naming rule
examples.text: Always typeset Lista de lectura separately. Do not abbreviate it to initials or incorporate Esteban into the symbol.

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: In the header, place the supported mark left of a compact text block. Use the exact name at 700 and the signature below at 400.

examples.title: Header specimen
examples.text:
Lista de lectura
Un ejemplo de Esteban

examples.title: Lockup dimensions
examples.text: Use a 48 px symbol canvas and a 12 px text gap on desktop; use a 40 px canvas and an 8 px gap on mobile.

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Reserve clear space around the complete lockup equal to one quarter of the symbol canvas. Keep this external space distinct from the internal mark-to-name gap.

examples.title: Desktop spacing
examples.text: A 48 px symbol canvas gives the Lista de lectura lockup 12 px of clear space from neighboring rules and controls.

examples.title: Mobile spacing
examples.text: A 40 px symbol canvas requires 10 px of clear space. The page still retains its separate 16 px outer margin.

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Keep the canonical violet symbol on its lilac support. Change the separately typeset name for contrast, not the symbol geometry or its internal colors.

examples.title: Light application
examples.text: On white or lilac, use Lista de lectura in #30233F beside the supported #6840AD bookmark.

examples.title: Dark application
examples.text: On #30233F or #6840AD, set the name in white and retain the complete lilac square behind the mark.

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the bookmark alone for compact identity surfaces. Preserve its vertical proportions, centered position and triangular lower notch at every size.

examples.title: Standalone use
examples.text: Center the canonical symbol on an application icon. Do not add a miniature Lista de lectura wordmark inside it.

examples.title: Record relationship
examples.text: Row markers borrow the bookmark silhouette as decorative state graphics. They are not alternate logos.

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, crop or embellish the logo. Avoid treatments that turn the bookmark into a book spine, shopping tag or generic initial badge.

examples.title: Do not redraw
examples.text: Do not round away the notch, add an L, replace the support with a cover image or introduce gradients and shadows.

examples.title: Do not rewrite
examples.text: Keep Lista de lectura exactly. Avoid Lista De Lectura, Esteban Books and any invented slogan beside the mark.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use Source Sans 3 throughout. Open this section with a large, left-aligned specimen and a smaller practical line rather than a decorative alphabet poster.

examples.title: Tu próxima lectura empieza aquí
examples.text: Añade un título y, si quieres, su autor.

examples.title: Section hierarchy
examples.text: Use 700 for the specimen heading and 400 for its supporting line. Retain the same plum-on-lilac contrast as the interface.

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: One family creates continuity between identity and controls. Distinguish levels through size, weight and spacing, not competing typefaces.

examples.title: Lista de lectura
examples.text: Título · Autor · Guardar libro

examples.title: Family discipline
examples.text: Use Source Sans 3 for names, books, labels, filters, errors and help. Avoid serif book-title styling and monospaced interface text.

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Source Sans 3 provides the specified 400, 500, 600 and 700 weights. Serve the chosen font locally through the application rather than browser requests to Google.

examples.title: Don Quijote de la Mancha
examples.text: Miguel de Cervantes · Por leer

examples.title: Reading setting
examples.text: Set book titles at 20/26 px, weight 600. Set authors at 16/24 px, weight 400, with complete accents and original capitalization.

examples.title: Temporary fallback
examples.text: If the font cannot load, use a system sans-serif stack without clipping content. This is a fallback, not a second identity typeface.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use upright styles: 700 for the name and main heading, 600 for books and primary controls, 500 for compact labels, and 400 for body and help.

examples.title: Guardar libro
examples.text: Título obligatorio. Máximo 200 caracteres.

examples.title: Weight distinction
examples.text: Lista de lectura uses 700; Don Quijote de la Mancha uses 600; Título uses 500; its helper line uses 400.

examples.title: Style restraint
examples.text: Avoid synthetic bold, italics for entire records and uppercase actions. Preserve a calm, upright bibliographic rhythm.

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use the same family for help, limitations and errors at 14/20 px. Secondary text remains full-strength plum; size and placement provide the quieter hierarchy.

examples.title: Autor
examples.text: Opcional. Máximo 160 caracteres.

examples.title: Help placement
examples.text: Place the helper directly below its field. An error follows in garnet with explicit wording, never as a faint replacement for the label.

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Use 36/40 px for the desktop title and 28/32 px on mobile. Books use 20/26 px; body and fields use 16/24 px; help uses 14/20 px.

examples.title: Lista de lectura
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban

examples.title: Record hierarchy
examples.text: Don Quijote de la Mancha leads the row; Miguel de Cervantes follows; Por leer and Marcar como leído remain subordinate but readable.

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use a 1120 px maximum container at 1440 px, with a 320 px form beside a flexible list. At 768 px, stack form, filters and records in one column.

examples.title: Título
examples.text: Añade tu próxima lectura. El autor es opcional.

examples.title: 390 px composition
examples.text: Keep 16 px margins. Budget about 112 px for header and note, 240 px for form and action, and 64 px for spacing and filters.

examples.title: Flow and spacing
examples.text: Use 4, 8, 12, 16, 24 and 32 px spacing. Wrap full titles, authors and unbroken strings; put mobile actions below text. Use normal page scrolling.

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Build recognition through lilac surroundings, a continuous white register and plum typography. Reserve violet for identity and actionable emphasis.

examples.title: Primary pairing
examples.text: Set Lista de lectura in #30233F on #F4F0FA. Place the bibliographic register on #FFFFFF.

examples.title: Action emphasis
examples.text: Use #6840AD with white text for Guardar libro. Do not give every row or helper a violet background.

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Keep all supplied hex values exact. Text and muted roles share the same plum; confirmation green and error garnet are additional semantic tokens.

examples.title: Structural palette
examples.text: Calm Lilac #F4F0FA · Reading Paper #FFFFFF · Active Violet #6840AD · Plum Ink #30233F · Quiet Ink #30233F

examples.title: Semantic accents
examples.text: Confirmation #236448 supports Libro guardado en este navegador. Error #A12643 supports No se pudo confirmar el guardado.

examples.title: Contrast roles
examples.text: Keep normal text at least 4.5:1 and essential boundaries and focus at least 3:1. Pair semantic colors with explicit words and symbols.

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Use the supplied lilac as the light field rather than inventing tint scales. Never reduce text opacity to create secondary hierarchy.

examples.title: Quiet information
examples.text: Set Opcional. Máximo 160 caracteres. in solid #30233F at 14/20 px, not translucent plum.

examples.title: Interactive states
examples.text: Distinguish hover, focus, pressed, disabled and pending with outlines, underlines, symbols and labels rather than pale color alone.

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: A left vertical rule connects row bookmarks across the continuous white list. Animate only a confirmed state change: a vertical fill transform lasting 180 ms.

examples.title: State motif
examples.text: Por leer uses an outlined bookmark; Leído uses a filled bookmark. Keep both labels visible and hide decorative markers from assistive technology.

examples.title: Motion behavior
examples.text: Move fill inside a fixed silhouette without shifting text. With reduced motion, show the final state immediately and retain the same focus and announcements.

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple geometric icons that share the bookmark's clarity. Pair status and recovery symbols with text; do not introduce unexplained icon-only actions.

examples.title: Completed state
examples.text: A check symbol accompanies Leído. The action remains visibly labelled Volver a por leer.

examples.title: Recovery state
examples.text: An alert symbol accompanies No se pudo confirmar el guardado. Keep Reintentar as the clear, text-labelled recovery action.

pages.title: Photography
pages.summary: Do not use photography in this identity's interface. Let typography, the bookmark and the record surface carry the reading theme without fabricated covers.

examples.title: Empty register
examples.text: Show Tu próxima lectura empieza aquí inside the recognizable list surface, without a stock image of books.

examples.title: Content-led expression
examples.text: Use a complete title and author as the visual specimen. Avoid cropped pages, simulated spines and repeated cover cards.

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build the visual reference board from bibliographic alignment, paper-like surfaces and bookmark geometry. Keep the selected register direction distinct from shelves and status boards.

examples.title: Reference strip
examples.text: Combine a lilac field, white register, plum title, violet bookmark and a thin connecting rule.

examples.title: Chosen rhythm
examples.text: Show Don Quijote de la Mancha wrapping naturally above its author and action. Do not arrange records as covers or separated status columns.

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: All following applications are design studies. Carry the same compact lockup, left alignment and honest Spanish copy across surfaces without implying extra product features.

examples.title: Lista de lectura
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban

examples.title: Shared composition
examples.text: Use one dominant reading line, one supporting line and restrained violet emphasis. Physical pieces do not imply commerce, membership or new routes.

pages.title: Social media icons
pages.summary: Design study: use only the canonical supported bookmark as an avatar. Keep the square asset intact and comfortably inside any circular display crop.

examples.title: Lista de lectura
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban

examples.title: Avatar rule
examples.text: Center the 160 × 160 geometry on lilac. Keep names and signatures in adjacent profile text rather than shrinking them into the avatar.

pages.title: Social media profiles
pages.summary: Design study: pair the bookmark avatar with the exact display name and a brief factual description. Do not invent handles, audience counts or active social accounts.

examples.title: Lista de lectura
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban. App ficticia para guardar próximas lecturas y marcar libros como leídos. Datos solo en el navegador.

examples.title: Profile composition
examples.text: Use plum text and a lilac header field. Avoid promotional banners, ratings and claims that books follow the reader between devices.

pages.title: Instagram posts
pages.summary: Design study: use a single typographic reading record on white within a lilac frame. Keep the title dominant and avoid simulated screenshots of unbuilt functionality.

examples.title: Una lectura por recordar
examples.text: Don Quijote de la Mancha · Miguel de Cervantes · Por leer

examples.title: Post structure
examples.text: Place the supported mark and Lista de lectura in a compact footer. Use no invented engagement counts, review scores or book-cover artwork.

pages.title: Posters
pages.summary: Design study: enlarge the bibliographic rhythm, not the interface chrome. Use one headline, a short explanatory line and the supported identity lockup.

examples.title: Tu próxima lectura empieza aquí
examples.text: Lista de lectura · Un ejemplo de Esteban

examples.title: Poster hierarchy
examples.text: Set the headline in 700 on lilac. Use a white vertical record panel and one violet bookmark; omit QR codes and invented destinations.

pages.title: T shirts and totes
pages.summary: Design study: use a restrained identity print rather than merchandise messaging. Keep the full supported symbol and a separately typeset name.

examples.title: Lista de lectura
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban

examples.title: Print placement
examples.text: On a light tote, place the lilac-supported violet mark above the plum name. Preserve the notch and clear space; add no price or shop reference.

pages.title: Reading sleeves
pages.summary: Design study: adapt the wrapping format into a paper sleeve for a reading note. Use a white field, lilac band and compact lockup without suggesting book sales.

examples.title: Sleeve composition
examples.text: Keep writing lines clear of folds. Place Lista de lectura at the upper left and use a single vertical violet rule to echo the register.

pages.title: Reading station
pages.summary: Design study: translate pickup wayfinding into an orientation card for a reading desk. Identify the activity without inventing a public venue, address or opening hours.

examples.title: Apunta tu próxima lectura
examples.text: Escribe el título y, si quieres, el autor.

examples.title: Orientation rule
examples.text: Use a large plum heading on white with a violet bookmark at the left. Do not add collection counters, location pins or service promises.

pages.title: Reading controls
pages.summary: Design study for /: keep visible field labels, explicit limits and a violet save action. Filters use 44 px minimum targets and a clear pressed state.

examples.title: Guardar libro
examples.text: Título: obligatorio, máximo 200 caracteres. Autor: opcional, máximo 160 caracteres.

examples.title: Todos · Por leer · Leídos
examples.text: Use buttons with aria-pressed. Keep the chosen filter after saving; offer Ver por leer when it hides the newly added book.

examples.title: Pending and invalid
examples.text: Keep invalid submission available so errors can be explained. Show Guardando… during a pending save; prevent repeated sends and keep linked errors in flow.

pages.title: Save confirmation
pages.summary: Design study: replace a receipt with an inline, browser-specific confirmation. Show success only after verified persistence; keep the reader on the same screen.

examples.title: Libro guardado en este navegador
examples.text: El libro está en Por leer. Ver por leer.

examples.title: Row confirmation
examples.text: Announce «Don Quijote de la Mancha: marcado como leído». Update its existing row without changing addition order; restore focus if the filter removes it.

examples.title: Unconfirmed save
examples.text: Retain fields and confirmed records. Place Reintentar beside the affected operation; a retry must not create another copy of the same pending addition.

pages.title: Reading card
pages.summary: Design study: adapt the loyalty-card format into a simple paper reading record. Use status words instead of points, stamps, tiers or membership claims.

examples.title: Mi lectura
examples.text:
Título: ____________________
Estado: Por leer / Leído

examples.title: Card structure
examples.text: Place a bookmark beside each status label and retain generous writing space. Do not imply that the paper card connects to browser storage.

pages.title: Reading station sign
pages.summary: Design study: translate venue signage into a neutral reading-area sign. Prioritize the name, preserve logo clear space and omit invented location details.

examples.title: Lista de lectura
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban

examples.title: Sign treatment
examples.text: Use white type on plum, with the canonical lilac-supported bookmark at the left. Include no opening hours, booking messages or directional claims.

pages.title: Reading website
pages.summary: Design study for the sole route /: compact header, one storage note, form and continuous register. No landing page, database, accounts, deletion, commerce or remote services.

examples.title: Lista de lectura
examples.text: App ficticia de ejemplo. Los libros se guardan solo en este navegador; no se sincronizan y pueden perderse al borrar sus datos.

examples.title: Screen hierarchy
examples.text: Place Un ejemplo de Esteban below the name. Use document title Lista de lectura — Esteban and Spanish language metadata. Keep filters above the white list.

examples.title: Honest screen states
examples.text: Show Cargando tu lista… before resolving browser storage. Then show records or Tu próxima lectura empieza aquí; never treat a failed read as an empty list.

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: derive the favicon, 192 px and 512 px PNG icons and apple-touch icon from the canonical geometry. These assets do not add interface routes.

examples.title: Lista de lectura — Esteban
examples.text: Lista de lectura

examples.title: Small-size expression
examples.text: Keep the violet bookmark centered on lilac in app/icon.svg and raster derivatives. Retain the complete notch and use no miniature lettering.

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Design study: use a reading-note sheet with the compact lockup at the upper left. Align text to a vertical rule and leave most of the white page open.

examples.title: Sheet hierarchy
examples.text: Use Source Sans 3 for every label. Keep the signature smaller than Lista de lectura and avoid fictional addresses, legal details or contact information.

pages.title: Introduction cards
pages.summary: Design study: adapt a business card into a project introduction card. Pair the exact identity with a brief description, not an invented professional role or contact channel.

examples.title: Lista de lectura
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban. Una app ficticia para recordar próximas lecturas y registrar las leídas.

examples.title: Two-sided layout
examples.text: Use the supported mark and name on the lilac front. Put the short description in plum on the white reverse, without URLs, phone numbers or QR codes.

pages.title: Reading recommendation card
pages.summary: Design study: reinterpret the gift-card format as a personal reading recommendation. Keep it non-monetary, with no balance, redemption code or purchase implication.

examples.title: Recommendation layout
examples.text: Place a small supported bookmark above the writing area. Use a lilac reverse with Lista de lectura and the exact Esteban signature.

pages.title: Reading sleeve seal
pages.summary: Design study: use a small identity label to close the paper reading sleeve. Preserve the supported bookmark rather than inventing a certification badge.

examples.title: Lista de lectura
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban

examples.title: Seal treatment
examples.text: Use the canonical square symbol as the label. Keep the name on the sleeve when space is tight; add no quality claims, prices or security language.

pages.title: Reader assistance
pages.summary: Design study: keep recovery beside the affected form, filter or book. Preserve confirmed records and inputs; explain blocked browser storage without implying remote backup.

examples.title: No se pudo confirmar el guardado
examples.text: Tus campos se conservan. Reintentar.

examples.title: Este libro cambió en otra pestaña
examples.text: Don Quijote de la Mancha. Estado local: Por leer. Estado almacenado: Leído. Conservar estado almacenado / Aplicar mi cambio.

examples.title: No podemos guardar en este contexto
examples.text: Block changes when storage or Web Locks is unavailable, including in an iframe. Offer Reintentar; for unreadable or incompatible data, offer Volver a leer.
